decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher draws directly on the firm's core postpress application and service know-how. That lets it read customer feedback and keep refining the product, so it stays in the portfolio.

The sheet preparation module builds on the firm's modular finishing systems and complements other lines. Absorptive capacity is high, and there is no sign of weak results that would justify withdrawal.

The B2 multifinisher is a flagship at the heart of the firm's multifinishing competence. It fits the move toward automated workflows, and the firm can interpret and improve it through its existing expertise.

The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and has a documented customer installation running in one pass. That gives interpretable results the firm can learn from, so keeping it is clearly warranted.
